name: Steel & Metals Skip-Month Momentum L/S
description: Cross-sectional skip-month momentum long/short strategy on 6 steel and metals stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, CENX). Signal: 12-month return excluding the most recent month (252d to 21d ago). Monthly rebalance: long top 3, short bottom 3, equal weight (~16.67% each), dollar-neutral (50% long / 50% short).
source:
# Steel & Metals Skip-Month Momentum Long/Short
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 6 steel & metals stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, CENX)
# - Signal: Skip-month momentum — 12-month return excluding most recent month
#           i.e., (close >> 21) / (close >> 252) - 1
# - Selection: Long top 3, Short bottom 3 by skip-month momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight within long/short portfolios (~16.67% each)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)
# - Dollar-neutral: 50% long leg, 50% short leg

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Skip-month momentum: return from 252 days ago to 21 days ago
# Skips the most recent month to avoid short-term reversal
skip_month_mom = (close >> 21) / (close >> 252) - 1

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by skip-month momentum (long), bottom 3 (short)
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(skip_month_mom)
is_bottom_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.bottom, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(skip_month_mom)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals for LONG positions
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Monthly rebalance signals for SHORT positions
enter_short = is_new_month and is_bottom_3
exit_short = is_new_month and not is_bottom_3
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short, exit=exit_short)

# Entry/Exit zones (long-short strategy)
# long_and_short_zone handles direction: long for held_long, short for held_short
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Equal weight across ALL active positions (both long and short)
# position_size only takes magnitude; direction comes from long_and_short_zone
is_active = held_long or held_short
weights = equal_weight()(is_active)

# Position sizing - ONLY rebalance on first trading day of month
# Size is always positive; long_and_short_zone determines direction
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
